source: Provisional. CBSE had not published a Class 9 Social Science question paper design for the new 2026-27 book (checked 15 Nov 2026); this follows the usual CBSE Social Science layout (as in the Class 10 sample paper). Schools set the annual paper, so check your school's blueprint.

sections.name: Section D
sections.note: Long answers, about 120 words. Many schools set one of these as a 5-mark map question (outline map of India or the world).

notes: All questions compulsory; internal choices as marked.
